s2.ptxt: Following the on-screen instructions, select "ECU Data Monitor" - "O2 Sensor Voltage B1S1".
Maintain the engine speed at 2500r/min for approximately 2 minutes to warm up the oxygen sensor.
Maintain the engine speed at 2500r/min and check that the SST (TaSCAN) reading changes between 0-1V (feedback).

specitem.ptxt: Changes 8 times or more in 10 seconds

item.ptxt: Perform this immediately after the warm-up operation, as the oxygen sensor will cool down.
If the value does not change, perform the warm-up operation again and check.

s2.ptxt: Following the screen display, select [ECU Data Monitor] → [A/F Sensor Voltage B1S1] and check the voltage.

s3.ptxt: Hold the engine speed at 2500 r/min for approximately 2 minutes to warm up the air fuel ratio sensor.
At idle speed, check that the voltage indicated by SST (TaSCAN) is 3 - 3.5 V.

atten3.ptxt: Perform this immediately after the sensor warm-up operation, as the air fuel ratio sensor will cool down.

s2.ptxt: After starting the engine, disconnect the vacuum hose of the vacuum switching valve assembly No.1.
Operate following the screen display, select "Active Test" - "Purge VSV", and check that vacuum is generated at the VSV port when the VSV is turned ON.
If the inspection result is abnormal, inspect the following items.

item.ptxt: Clogged vacuum hose (intake air surge tank - VSV)

s2.ptxt: End the "Active Test" and connect the vacuum hose of the vacuum switching valve assembly No.1.
Operate following the screen display, display the "Data Monitor" screen, and select "Purge VSV" so that the operating condition of the purge VSV can be checked.
After the vehicle is fully warmed up, drive with sufficient acceleration and deceleration, and check that the VSV changes from "OFF→ON".

s-1.ptxt: Visually Inspect Hoses, Connections and Gaskets

s2.ptxt: Inspect the hoses for cracks, leaks or damage.

item.ptxt: Removing the oil level gauge, oil filler cap, PCV hose, etc. may cause engine malfunction or engine stall.
If parts between the throttle body and cylinder head are disconnected, loose or cracked, 2-ary air will be drawn in, causing engine malfunction or engine stall.

s3.ptxt: Close port B and, while blowing air into port A, check that air flows from port C.
Close port C, blow air into port A, and check that air flows from port B.
Close port C and, while applying vacuum (1.96kPa) to port A, check that air is drawn in from port B.

s2.ptxt: Inspect the cap and gasket for damage.
